description:
## Mandatory context and boundaries
Read the parent epic first. Applicable owners: AGENTS.md; docs/agent-tools.md; docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md; docs/action-reuse.md; docs/testing-approach.md; docs/services/channels.md (communication/Jido bridge and provider contracts); docs/services/engine.md (history, admission, finalization and delivery). Read docs/documentation.md before documentation/skill edits, docs/services/system-config.md before credential fixtures, and local module @moduledoc before extending a helper. Apply code-quality for code and skill-creator for the skill.
Only test/ additions or backward-compatible support changes, lib/mix/tasks/zaq.test.gen.channel.ex, and .agents/skills/add-channel-integration-tests/** are authorized. Do not edit application modules, dependency source/pins, config, migrations, mix.exs, CI, or unrelated skills. Existing-test expectation changes require the testing handbook's explicit approval; this epic authorizes additive coverage, not changing expectations.
Use real bridges, NodeRouter, Engine admission/history/persistence and configured Agent execution. Only provider/LLM boundaries are faked. A production defect is a reported blocker with a reproducer; do not patch production, silently omit a scenario, weaken an assertion, or close the issue as complete.
Validation timing, failure handling and final gates are owned by docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Record executed commands/results in this issue. No new browser E2E is needed: this work adds test/developer infrastructure without changing a deployed UI journey. No commit/push/merge authorization is implied.

Parent epic: zaq-o9d

## Functional specification and files
Own test/zaq/channels/integration/transcript_test.exs and transcript readers/assertions in test/support/channels/integration/assertions.ex. Enumerate Registry.all/0 using the same case/session contract. Use Conversations.list_canonical_messages/3 for caller-visible reads; scoped Repo reads may locate exact transcript/placement/execution identifiers and assert stored invariants, never fabricate expected output.
Per provider:
- A direct exchange creates the correct direct transcript and exact ordered prompt/final answer with native source ids, stable canonical ids, attribution and connector/room scope.
- Mentioned shared-room input creates shared history; passive room input is captured according to current external-message role semantics without an Agent execution.
- Follow-up context uses only authorized history and cannot absorb another Person/room/connector's content.
- Identical external message ids in different connector scopes remain distinct. Telegram adds the same id in different chats. Replay does not duplicate canonical placements.
- Direct participant can read; unrelated Person and missing identity cannot gain history access. Shared access follows real provider grants; separately named manual-grant fixtures test explicit grant/revocation. Do not pre-grant the automatic membership scenario in a way that hides a provider-admission regression.
- For evidenced thread support, assert parent id, native thread key, retained root/local history and bounded parent context. Mattermost thread-root policy is mandatory; Telegram/WhatsApp unsupported fetch semantics fail closed without manufacturing history.
Output readable failure evidence containing only synthetic test content and bounded provider/message/transcript coordinates. Keep LLM raw secrets, full private execution traces and credentials out. The API must permit a test to inspect a transcript after completion, satisfying the user's request to see shared/direct history.

## Tests to add before implementation
Author exact persisted assertions for the scenarios above. Add focused property tests for scope/id separation across bounded generated identifiers using existing history/provider fixture boundaries; do not launch full LLM runtimes for hundreds of samples. Assert expected values independently of production normalization routines.
Exercise read-denial outcomes and revocation after a previously successful read. A nil Person is never an implicit privileged fixture.
Verify failed/partial delivery is not misreported as a confirmed assistant placement (coordinate with the next issue).

## Branches/paths validated
Direct/shared, passive/answered, root/thread, same-id replay versus different scope, authorized/unauthorized/revoked reads, model context composition and ordered confirmation-backed placements.

## Mocking plan
Only provider/LLM. Real HistoryIngress, Conversations, TranscriptHistory, grants, delivery confirmation and Repo. Test fixture helpers may create unrelated People/permissions through normal APIs; they may not insert the messages/transcripts whose creation is being asserted.

## Documentation
Add sample readable transcript output and field semantics to README/module docs, including generated execution versus confirmed public transcript distinction. No product UI is added.

## Action reuse assessment
Reuse Conversations.list_canonical_messages/3, existing history/grant APIs, actual admission/finalization and canonical delivery capture. Helpers are local-only read/assertion composition. Verification proves persisted messages and access rules; no new domain operation, Action or permission bypass.

## Done when
The required direct/shared/permission/isolation matrix passes for every registered completed driver, native/canonical identifiers are checked, and transcript failures are readable and bounded.

comments.text: Implemented all-driver direct/shared ordered canonical content, native ids, attribution, real provider grants, nil/unrelated-person denial, manual grant/revoke, cross-connector identical ids and model-context isolation. Native parent/thread retained history passes Mattermost and WhatsApp; Telegram fails outbound ExGram integer validation tracked as zaq-gr2, preserving exact reproducer. Added bounded source-id property across two real native Mattermost provider sessions with passive capture/replay and no LLM executions (15 runs); property passes. Issue remains open only for Telegram thread acceptance. No production fix or relaxed expectation.

title: [zaq-o9d.7] Verify direct/shared transcript contents, permissions and source-scope isolation
